title: A Hollow for the Sigil
author: Cyrus Zhou
blurb: Ada Ashgrove, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
